# Ednex Academy
> Career-focused practical training institute in India offering intensive, job-ready
> programs in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing
> and Web Development — with hands-on projects and placement support.

## Programs
- [Digital Marketing Course](https://ednexacademy.com/digital-marketing.html): Advanced Certificate in Digital Marketing — SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, content and growth funnels. 3 months, live online.
- [Data Analytics Course](https://ednexacademy.com/data-analyst.html): Data analytics and business intelligence with Python, SQL, Power BI and machine learning projects.
- [Artificial Intelligence Course](https://ednexacademy.com/artificial-intelligence.html): AI and Agentic AI systems, hands-on machine learning and AI application building.
- [Cyber Security Course](https://ednexacademy.com/cybersecurity.html): Ethical hacking, vulnerability assessment and security operations fundamentals.
- [Python Course](https://ednexacademy.com/python.html): Python 3 from basics to OOP, web scraping, REST APIs and automation.
- [SQL Course](https://ednexacademy.com/sql.html): SQL and relational databases for analyst roles.
- [Micro-Skilled Courses](https://ednexacademy.com/micro-skilled-courses.html): Short, certified, job-oriented skill programs.

## About
